usage: run_benchmark [-h] [--truth TRUTH] [--predictions-out PREDICTIONS_OUT]
                     [--scorecard-out SCORECARD_OUT]
                     [--iou-threshold IOU_THRESHOLD]
                     [--time-tolerance TIME_TOLERANCE] [--quiet]

Eyeline Pillar-1 Benchmark Evaluation Runner

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --truth TRUTH         Path to ground-truth JSON (default: bench/truth.json)
  --predictions-out PREDICTIONS_OUT
                        Path to save measured predictions JSON (default:
                        bench/fixtures/measured_predictions.json)
  --scorecard-out SCORECARD_OUT
                        Path to save scored summary JSON (default:
                        bench/fixtures/scorecard.json)
  --iou-threshold IOU_THRESHOLD
                        Minimum spatial IoU for a localized true positive
                        (default: 0.3)
  --time-tolerance TIME_TOLERANCE
                        Timestamp tolerance in seconds for defect matching
                        (default: 0.5)
  --quiet               Suppress per-pair stdout logging (default: False)
